definitions: To clarify or confirm the correct understanding and usage of specific terms or vocabulary.
To ensure that everyone involved in a discussion or task is using and interpreting specialized words or phrases in the same way.
examples: Before we proceed, let's make sure you have the terminology straight regarding the project phases.
The instructor paused to make sure the students had the terminology straight before moving to the next concept.
It's important to make sure you have the terminology straight when discussing legal documents.
lemma: to make sure you have the terminology straight
source: to make sure you have the terminology straight
